defaults.description: Suggested values the user can change. Same keys as the enforced settings.

destination.description: Where new tickets go: local (My tickets only), email, webhook, jira, zendesk, freshdesk or servicenow. Tickets are always kept in My tickets too.

helpdeskEmail.description: Help-desk address for the email destination. Empty uses the brand support email.

webhookUrl.description: URL that receives each ticket as JSON (POST), including the screenshot as base64.

webhookToken.description: Optional token sent as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" to the webhook.

jiraEmail.description: Atlassian account email used with the API token.

jiraServiceDeskId.description: Jira Service Management service desk id. With a request type id, tickets are created as customer requests.

jiraRequestTypeId.description: Jira Service Management request type id.

jiraProjectKey.description: Jira project key, used when no service desk id is set (creates a plain issue).

jiraIssueType.description: Issue type name for plain Jira issues, e.g. Task or Bug.

zendeskEmail.description: Zendesk agent email used with the API token.

categories.description: Categories offered in the ticket form.

defaultPriority.description: Priority preselected in the ticket form: low, normal, high or urgent.

requiredFields.description: Fields that must be filled: summary, description, category, requesterName, requesterEmail.

requesterName.description: Requester name prefilled in the ticket form.

requesterEmail.description: Requester email prefilled in the ticket form.

rememberRequester.description: Remember the name and email typed in the ticket form for next time.

includeDiagnostics.description: Attach browser and page diagnostics to new tickets by default.

includeUrl.description: Include the page URL (and failed request URLs) in diagnostics.

redactColor.description: Fill colour of the redact tool.

maxTickets.description: How many tickets to keep in My tickets (oldest are removed first).

keepScreenshots.description: Keep the full screenshot with saved tickets. Off keeps only a small thumbnail.

shareScreenshots.description: Include screenshots when tickets are sent to the linked shared-data backend.

brand.description: Enforced brand kit fields (locked in Settings -> Branding).

connection.description: Optional shared-data backend. type: none | webhook | rest | supabase.
